capabilities: Subscribe to RSS, Atom and RDF feeds and sort them into groups
Read articles in a dedicated reader tab with unread and starred filters
Extract full text from article pages when feeds only ship summaries
Save articles as Markdown notes using configurable file, front matter and body templates
Import and export subscriptions as OPML
extras: README documents security hardening of untrusted feed markup, cache migration, troubleshooting for rate-limited feeds via RSS bridges, and mobile-specific layout; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and it was previously named rss-subscribe.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to follow web feeds or turn feed articles into notes inside the vault.
summary: RSS reader that subscribes to RSS, Atom and RDF feeds, shows articles in a sidebar list and reader tab, and saves articles as Markdown notes.
